scope.platform: Android16/API36 Google APIs ARM64 userdebug isolated emulator
scope.test_actor: Maintainer with real Python CLI, actual candidate APK, Android system notification and Airtap UI
scope.setup: ADB installation and accessibility/notification grants; self-hosted service address and six-digit approval through App UI. Synthetic local credentials only.
scope.tls: Regular production TLS/hostname verification; a fresh synthetic CA was added only to disposable AVD system trust. Candidate APK was not changed.
scope.network: Candidate app UID restricted to loopback; local production workerd/Miniflare relay with HTTPS edge fault fixture.
scope.cleanup: Own emulator, AVD and relay stopped/removed. Existing devices untouched.

handshake_recovery.fault: TLS completes and HTTP Upgrade is deliberately held without any response on one real OkHttp websocket
handshake_recovery.operation_replay: Only deliberate later HOME was issued; no timed-out action was replayed.

notification_owner_stop.trigger: Normal Android notification Stop control while a later websocket HTTP upgrade was pending
notification_owner_stop.interpretation: Local trust removed. Approved relay metadata alone is not server revocation; 503 outcome unknown is preserved as such.

full_owner_revoke.new_pair_authorization: After successful local-stop test, explicitly chose Invite my AI, paired a fresh synthetic controller, compared six-digit code, and approved in App UI. This was not automatic recovery of stopped trust.
full_owner_revoke.trigger: App Stop and disconnect AI while websocket HTTP upgrade was pending

retained_failures.detail: Immediately after baseline HOME, foreground returned window_metadata_unavailable during transition; not hidden or repeated as an action. Post-recovery foreground succeeded and identified launcher.
Initial SDK image download/unzip failed SeekableByteChannel Zip content; one retry succeeded.
UI set-text succeeded but parser failed on additional instrumentation result line. Parser changed to select exact nodes line.
First stop-test prerequisite ran between stalled timeout and next attempt, so it failed before stop. Waited explicitly for pending upgrade; another expected 30s timeout during setup was retained.
After successful notification stop, ADB stripped empty settings parameter and interrupted restoration script. Resumed only verification with settings delete; no stop or unknown HOME action replayed.

not_claimed: All possible late callback races or DNS/TLS stalls tested natively
Server-only remote revocation without simultaneous local stop
evidence_boundary: Reviewed summary of private synthetic receipts and metadata. Screenshots, invitation/claim/controller/device tokens, namespaces, connection IDs, private host paths, real phone contents and production credentials are excluded. Original private evidence is retained separately.

source_binding.test_artifact_binding: Native tests ran on the candidate before this commit was created. A subsequent clean export of this exact commit rebuilt an APK identical byte-for-byte to that candidate; test results therefore refer to those same APK bytes.
source_binding.not_claimed: This is one verified local rebuild, not a claim that every future environment produces identical APK bytes.
